design_rules: CSW-01 fragment identity/lifecycle and CSW-02 Library/Project Memory remain controlling.
Generated alternatives never silently overwrite the seed.
Duplicate/related discovery is authorization-filtered and advisory.
Optional AI is context-filtered, attributable and candidate-only.

implementation_boundary: Planning only; application implementation/persistence migrations remain unauthorized.
